title: Indian Lentil Stew
description: A flavorful and nutritious Indian-inspired stew made with red lentils, onions, and spices. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Add stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Stir in cheese (if using) and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro (if desired).
Note: Cooking time may vary depending on personal preference for lentil texture.
For a thicker stew, mash some of the lentils against the side of the pan before serving.
